meta.title: Beerwolf — personal websites for furry identities
meta.description: Personal websites for furry identities, designed and built like art commissions.

hero.eyebrow: Independent web commissions · open for signals
hero.description: Your fursona, references, favorite sounds and strange little details become a one-of-one website — developed together, built turnkey, and never pulled from a template shelf.
hero.posterAlt: Abstract screen-printed wolf signal made from geometric shapes

process.eyebrow: No agency maze. No template lottery.
process.title: A commission process with every pawprint visible.
process.intro: You bring the character and the feeling. I turn it into a visual system, keep the work transparent, and handle the technical parts all the way to launch.

steps.title: We build the visual concept together
steps.body: We collect artwork, character notes, music, subculture references, colors, websites and tiny obsessions. Then we find the visual thread that feels unmistakably yours.

steps.title: Your identity shapes the interface
steps.body: Composition, type, motion and interaction grow around your fursona and community presence. The result should look lived-in, not configured.

steps.title: Turnkey from sketch to live URL
steps.body: I handle design, frontend development, responsive behavior, deployment and technical setup. You focus on ideas, feedback and the content only you can provide.

steps.title: See the work while it happens
steps.body: A compact project board shows what is queued, in progress, ready to review and complete. No mysterious silence between updates.

steps.title: The Telegram bot keeps everything together
steps.body: Check status, request revisions, collect files and receive important project updates without searching through five different services.

steps.title: Launch is not a disappearance act
steps.body: Technical support stays available after release for fixes, maintenance and the inevitable new idea that appears once the site is alive.
